reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.comment: These extensions are just beautiful and very easy to install. I was surprised that it was easier plugging in the 24-pin motherboard cable and the GPU cables much easier then what came with my power supply that was a pleasant surprise! They feel very high quality especially for the price and I only have one minor gripe, that being that the combs are too loose and it's hard to get them to stay in place. The combs you see in the picture I purchased separately because if you look at the graphics card I have a single 16 pin comb that did not come with the formula mod kit. So now I have a new dilemma if you can call it that. I'll be getting a graphics card that requires three 8-pin connections and therefore will need an additional 8-pin cable and I contacted formula mod and I have to say the customer support is outstanding! They're going to send me an additional one with only a small charge for shipping and throwing some 24 pin Combs as well so I'm loving my first experience with this brand. Highly recommended
reviews.author: Tory

reviews.title: Great cables for a great price.
reviews.comment: These cables look great, and were very easy to install. As some other reviewers have noted, the GPU cables bend up (over the top of the GPU in a standard setup), but it's fairly easy to bend them the other direction. I'd recommend purchasing some standalone cable combs - the ones these come with work fine, but they don't look quite as good as black IMO, and if your GPU has a 3+4 pin arrangement (like quite a few cards do), you won't be able to separate the 4th set of cables on the left (the included clear combs aren't removable). It's also worth noting that the cables are arranged 1 2 3 3 2 1 1 1, so if your GPU has a 3+4 pin arrangement, the leftmost colored cable (3 in the diagram, purple in the set I purchased) will be missing, though it still looks fine. Overall, very happy with this purchase!

reviews.title: Looks great, great value
reviews.comment: Nice extensions that will work with any power supply. Included combs work well to train cables, though I wish there was 1 or 2 more for each run. Using 24, 4+4, 8, and 6 pin cables in my system. No power issues in any components. Cables are a bit thinner that other extensions, about the same thickness as standard PSU cables. Plastic sleeving is a bit stiff and took some effort to train initially, but has held it's shape well for several months after installation. Not in the level of quality of CableMod or other custom extensions, but FAR better value for money.
